<b>Kakris</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Dexterous flying scouts wielding blades, they are members of the [[Order of Karak]], long lost to time and living on only in memory.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Kakris are flying enemies and frequently dart between aerial positions. They often flit about before darting just out of Hornet's horizontal range and performing one of two attacks:
* <b>Triple Slash:</b> Rears back slightly before slashing thrice, moving forward slightly on the first slash. Deals {{Damage|1+1|}} if Hornet is hit by any of the slashes.
* <b>Corkscrew Dash:</b> Charges up briefly and does a horizontal dive towards Hornet whilst spinning with their blades, going in a very slight upwards arc. If Hornet is hit by this attack at any time, it deals {{Damage|1+1}}.

== Location ==
Kakris can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
